recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If PA wants Encounter examples to avoid broad historical v3 ParticipationType codes as an editorial improvement, that should be handled by a new targeted tracker because FHIR-36014's value-set composition change is already applied.
issue_request: FHIR-36014 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking to remove the explicitly included v3 ParticipationType codes SPRF, PPRF, and PART from the Encounter participant type value set because PART was broad enough to make the extensible binding behave like a required binding.
initial_application: Commit c212a82696a805aa56193730c5523eda878e9562, titled 'FHIR-36014 Remove PART from Encounter ParticipantType', removed the separate v3-ParticipationType include containing SPRF, PPRF, and PART from source/encounter/valueset-encounter-participant-type.xml. No prior FHIR-36014 reconcile commit existed on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini and Encounter.participant.type binds extensibly to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-participant-type. FHIR-8376 historically added the three broad codes, but FHIR-36014 superseded that part of the earlier change. PA May 2022 WGM minutes confirmed the 8-0-0 persuasive vote and stated existing systems using removed codes would not be broken because the binding remains extensible. A later Zulip implementer thread noted the R5 absence of PPRF/SPRF/PART but did not surface a WG reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the authoritative current value set compose retains the remaining includes and no longer explicitly includes SPRF, PPRF, or PART.
